operations: Add Select field "Vendor Risk Rating" (custom_risk_rating) to Supplier after supplier_type, options: Low / Medium / High
Add Date field "Risk Review Date" (custom_risk_review_date) to Supplier after custom_risk_rating
Set mandatory_depends_on = eval:doc.custom_risk_rating=='High' on field "custom_risk_review_date" of Supplier
Add server script "validate_risk_review_date_when_high" on Supplier (before save)
change_sets.title: Supplier Risk Rating with Conditional Review Date

operations: Add Select field "Preferred Payment Method" (custom_preferred_payment_method) to Supplier after default_bank_account, mandatory, options: Bank Transfer / Cheque / UPI
Add Data field "UPI ID" (custom_upi_id) to Supplier after custom_preferred_payment_method
Set mandatory_depends_on = eval:doc.custom_preferred_payment_method=='UPI' on field "custom_upi_id" of Supplier
Add server script "Validate UPI ID when method is UPI" on Supplier (before save)
change_sets.title: Supplier preferred payment method with conditional UPI ID (ERPNext v15)
